summary: Lost Cities is a tight two-player card game where you play or discard cards to build ascending expeditions in five colors, weighing the risk of committing to a costly expedition against the point penalty for starting one at all. It's a quick, tense push-your-luck experience that plays in about 30 minutes.
praised: elegant, simple rules with real depth
classic Knizia design that holds up
criticised: can feel repetitive over many plays
luck of the draw can swing outcomes
purely two-player, no variant for groups

interaction.kind: shared discard piles and card counting/blocking

win_criteria: Most points, one or two sources

scoring.why: score is purely expedition totals across the colored suits, with a penalty for starting an expedition at all
